Quick Start Guide¶

Installation¶

Install the SDK:

pip install aether-sdk

Creating Your First Actor¶

from aether_sdk import Actor, Context

class GreetingActor(Actor):
    async def on_message(self, message: str, ctx: Context):
        await ctx.reply(f"Hello, {message}!")
